source_text: Of course. You ladies are free to watch it here if you’d like. I totally understand why you’d want to stay away from the church.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.Of course. You ladies are free to watch it here if you’d like. I totally understand why you’d want to stay away from the church.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.Of course. You ladies are free to watch it here if you’d like. I totally understand why you’d want to stay away from the church."

translation: Oczywiście. Możecie obejrzeć go tutaj, jeśli chcecie. Doskonale rozumiem, że wolicie trzymać się z dala od kościoła.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.I’m just thankful that the Lord protected all of us.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.I’m just thankful that the Lord protected all of us."

structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.Enjoy the news segment."

source_text: Heading somewhere, Heather?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Heading somewhere, Heather?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Heading somewhere, Heather?"

translation: Dokądś idziesz, Heather?

structure.raw_value: HeBaDe.Ella?
structure.script_literal: "HeBaDe.Ella?"

structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx.Just don’t leave Hannah out. She’ll throw a fit."

source_text: Of course Hannah’s invited.

structure.raw_value: ChFlDe^.Of course Hannah’s invited.
structure.script_literal: "ChFlDe^.Of course Hannah’s invited."

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.What about dinner? Are you girls planning anything?
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.What about dinner? Are you girls planning anything?"

translation: A co z kolacją? Macie jakiś plan?

source_text: I can cook something up for everyone.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx^.I can cook something up for everyone.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx^.I can cook something up for everyone."

translation: Mogę coś ugotować dla wszystkich.

source_text: I can help. I used to cook at Saint Dame.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I can help. I used to cook at Saint Dame.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I can help. I used to cook at Saint Dame."

translation: Mogę pomóc. Kiedyś gotowałam w Saint Dame.

source_text: Sounds like your evening is planned.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.Sounds like your evening is planned.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.Sounds like your evening is planned."

translation: Wygląda na to, że wieczór masz już zaplanowany.

source_text: I’ll make sure there are no messes.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ll make sure there are no messes.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ll make sure there are no messes."

translation: Dopilnuję, żeby nie było bałaganu.

source_text: We’ll be clean.

structure.raw_value: ChHaOp^.We’ll be clean.
structure.script_literal: "ChHaOp^.We’ll be clean."

translation: Będziemy grzeczne.

source_text: I better get going. Have fun.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.I better get going. Have fun.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.I better get going. Have fun."

translation: Lepiej już pójdę. Bawcie się dobrze.

structure.raw_value: ChFlOp^.1Hero… Can you invite Ella?
structure.script_literal: "ChFlOp^.1Hero… Can you invite Ella?"

translation: 1Hero… Możesz zaprosić Ellę?

source_text: I’ll let the other girls know there’s a party. What’s for dinner?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll let the other girls know there’s a party. What’s for dinner?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll let the other girls know there’s a party. What’s for dinner?"

translation: Powiem pozostałym dziewczynom, że jest impreza. Co będzie na kolację?

source_text: Chicken?

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp^.Chicken?
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp^.Chicken?"

translation: Kurczak?

source_text: How about chicken stir-fry? I think I remember how to make it.

structure.raw_value: JuHaEx.How about chicken stir-fry? I think I remember how to make it.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaEx.How about chicken stir-fry? I think I remember how to make it."

translation: Może kurczak z warzywami z patelni? Chyba pamiętam, jak się go robi.

source_text: I’ll let the girls know.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll let the girls know.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll let the girls know."

translation: Powiem dziewczynom.

source_text: Carol! You told her!?

structure.raw_value: McShEx.Carol! You told her!?
structure.script_literal: "McShEx.Carol! You told her!?"

translation: Carol! Powiedziałaś jej!?

source_text: Of course I did. You knew I would.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Of course I did. You knew I would.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Of course I did. You knew I would."

translation: Oczywiście. Wiedziałeś, że jej powiem.

source_text: How much did you tell her?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.How much did you tell her?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.How much did you tell her?"

translation: Ile jej powiedziałaś?

source_text: Don’t worry. I didn’t tell her that you shot a load in front of me.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Don’t worry. I didn’t tell her that you shot a load in front of me.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Don’t worry. I didn’t tell her that you shot a load in front of me."

translation: Spokojnie. Nie powiedziałam jej, że spuściłeś się przy mnie.

source_text: It was more than just that.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.It was more than just that.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.It was more than just that."

translation: Chodziło o coś więcej.

source_text: Calm down. I’m not going to go spilling too many secrets.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Calm down. I’m not going to go spilling too many secrets.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Calm down. I’m not going to go spilling too many secrets."

translation: Spokojnie. Nie zamierzam zdradzać zbyt wielu sekretów.

source_text: Besides, I think Heather would get mighty jealous of our little fun.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Besides, I think Heather would get mighty jealous of our little fun.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Besides, I think Heather would get mighty jealous of our little fun."

translation: Poza tym Heather mogłaby być bardzo zazdrosna o naszą małą zabawę.

source_text: 1Hero is here!

structure.raw_value: HnHaAg.1Hero is here!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAg.1Hero is here!"

translation: 1Hero już jest!

source_text: Looking good, girls.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Looking good, girls.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Looking good, girls."

translation: Świetnie wyglądacie, dziewczyny.

source_text: Yeah, I got off work a bit early.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Yeah, I got off work a bit early.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Yeah, I got off work a bit early."

translation: Tak, wyszedłem dziś trochę wcześniej z pracy.

source_text: Let’s go have some fun!

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Let’s go have some fun!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Let’s go have some fun!"

translation: Chodźmy się zabawić!

source_text: Poor 1Hero. Surrounded by beautiful ladies and no relationships in sight.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Poor 1Hero. Surrounded by beautiful ladies and no relationships in sight.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Poor 1Hero. Surrounded by beautiful ladies and no relationships in sight."

translation: Biedny 1Hero. Otaczają go piękne kobiety, a żadnego związku na horyzoncie.

source_text: You know how I feel.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.You know how I feel.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.You know how I feel."

translation: Wiesz, co o tym myślę.

source_text: Those girls will grow up and when they do, I think you’d make a good man for either one of them.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Those girls will grow up and when they do, I think you’d make a good man for either one of them.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Those girls will grow up and when they do, I think you’d make a good man for either one of them."

translation: Dziewczyny dorosną, a wtedy byłbyś świetnym partnerem dla każdej z nich.

source_text: Maybe you’re right… One day.

structure.raw_value: McFrDe.Maybe you’re right… One day.
structure.script_literal: "McFrDe.Maybe you’re right… One day."

translation: Może masz rację… Kiedyś.

source_text: Until then, you come to mama for all your needs. Ya hear?

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Until then, you come to mama for all your needs. Ya hear?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Until then, you come to mama for all your needs. Ya hear?"

translation: A do tego czasu przychodź do mamusi ze wszystkimi potrzebami. Jasne?

source_text: Carol? Are you serious?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Carol? Are you serious?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Carol? Are you serious?"

translation: Carol? Mówisz poważnie?

source_text: Don’t be so dramatic. I’m an old lady and you’re a man in his prime.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Don’t be so dramatic. I’m an old lady and you’re a man in his prime.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Don’t be so dramatic. I’m an old lady and you’re a man in his prime."

translation: Nie dramatyzuj. Jestem starszą kobietą, a ty jesteś w kwiecie wieku.

source_text: I’d love to help you with any… relationship problems. Physical or otherwise.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.I’d love to help you with any… relationship problems. Physical or otherwise.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.I’d love to help you with any… relationship problems. Physical or otherwise."

translation: Chętnie pomogę ci z… problemami w relacjach. Fizycznymi i innymi.

source_text: Haha… Yeah, sure thing, Carol.

structure.raw_value: McFrOpNo4.Haha… Yeah, sure thing, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOpNo4.Haha… Yeah, sure thing, Carol."

translation: Haha… Jasne, Carol.

source_text: She’s going to help you? What problems do you have, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.She’s going to help you? What problems do you have, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.She’s going to help you? What problems do you have, 1Hero?"

translation: Carol ci pomoże? Z jakimi problemami, 1Hero?

source_text: It’s not a big deal, Arianna.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It’s not a big deal, Arianna.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It’s not a big deal, Arianna. "

translation: To nic wielkiego, Arianno.

source_text: Is it something I can help you with?

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.Is it something I can help you with?
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.Is it something I can help you with?"

translation: Czy mogę ci jakoś pomóc?

source_text: Now that you mention it… Just how physical are you allowed to be?

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Now that you mention it… Just how physical are you allowed to be?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Now that you mention it… Just how physical are you allowed to be?"

translation: Skoro pytasz… Na ile możesz sobie pozwolić fizycznie?

source_text: I don’t understand? Physical?

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.I don’t understand? Physical?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.I don’t understand? Physical?"

translation: Nie rozumiem. Fizycznie?

source_text: Carol is helping me with… sexual problems.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Carol is helping me with… sexual problems.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Carol is helping me with… sexual problems."

translation: Carol pomaga mi z… problemami seksualnymi.

source_text: Oh, my! I can never help you with that! It is forbidden!

structure.raw_value: ArShClNo1.Oh, my! I can never help you with that! It is forbidden!
structure.script_literal: "ArShClNo1.Oh, my! I can never help you with that! It is forbidden!"

translation: Ojej! Nie mogę ci w tym pomóc! To zakazane!

source_text: So you’ve never done anything sexual at all?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.So you’ve never done anything sexual at all?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.So you’ve never done anything sexual at all?"

translation: Czyli nigdy nie robiłaś niczego seksualnego?

source_text: I sat on a rounded stone once. But I felt nothing! I swear!

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.I sat on a rounded stone once. But I felt nothing! I swear!
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.I sat on a rounded stone once. But I felt nothing! I swear!"

translation: Raz usiadłam na zaokrąglonym kamieniu. Ale nic nie poczułam! Przysięgam!

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Let’s just say, hypothetically, that you and I had sex.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Let’s just say, hypothetically, that you and I had sex."

translation: Załóżmy czysto hipotetycznie, że uprawialibyśmy seks.

source_text: It’s just a hypothetical.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.It’s just a hypothetical.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.It’s just a hypothetical."

translation: To tylko hipoteza.

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.I would lose my wings! I would be cast out of the empyrean, forced to live among demonkind, or worse yet, to live a mortal life among humans!
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.I would lose my wings! I would be cast out of the empyrean, forced to live among demonkind, or worse yet, to live a mortal life among humans!"

translation: Straciłabym skrzydła! Wygnano by mnie z Empyreum i musiałabym żyć pośród demonów albo, co gorsza, jako śmiertelniczka wśród ludzi!

source_text: We’re not that bad.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.We’re not that bad.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.We’re not that bad."

translation: Nie jesteśmy aż tacy źli.

source_text: Let us never speak of such things again.

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.Let us never speak of such things again.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.Let us never speak of such things again."

translation: Nigdy więcej o tym nie rozmawiajmy.

source_text: I have no knowledge of that sinful act and will not burden my mind with such thoughts.

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.I have no knowledge of that sinful act and will not burden my mind with such thoughts.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.I have no knowledge of that sinful act and will not burden my mind with such thoughts."

translation: Nic nie wiem o tym grzesznym akcie i nie zamierzam zaprzątać sobie nim głowy.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.You’ve never been wet… down there?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.You’ve never been wet… down there?"

translation: Nigdy nie byłaś… tam na dole mokra?

source_text: I’m not listening! I’m not listening!

structure.raw_value: ArHuAg!cNo5.I’m not listening! I’m not listening!
structure.script_literal: "ArHuAg!cNo5.I’m not listening! I’m not listening!"

translation: Nie słucham! Nie słucham!

source_text: Then I guess Carol is going to have to help me in that department.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Then I guess Carol is going to have to help me in that department.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Then I guess Carol is going to have to help me in that department."

translation: W takim razie chyba Carol będzie musiała mi w tym pomóc.

source_text: Oh, boy. Humankind is so dirty.

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.Oh, boy. Humankind is so dirty.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.Oh, boy. Humankind is so dirty."

translation: O rany. Ludzkość jest taka nieczysta.

source_text: I’ll live.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’ll live.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’ll live."

source_text: Carol told us everything.

structure.raw_value: ChSaOp^.Carol told us everything.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaOp^.Carol told us everything."

structure.raw_value: JuWoOp.What are you going to do, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoOp.What are you going to do, 1Hero?"

translation: Co zamierzasz zrobić, 1Hero?

source_text: I talked to Andrea… There’s nothing I can do right now.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I talked to Andrea… There’s nothing I can do right now.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I talked to Andrea… There’s nothing I can do right now."

translation: Rozmawiałem z Andreą… Na razie nic nie mogę zrobić.

source_text: Are you going to try and save your dad like in Star Wars?

structure.raw_value: HnShOp^.Are you going to try and save your dad like in Star Wars?
structure.script_literal: "HnShOp^.Are you going to try and save your dad like in Star Wars?"

translation: Spróbujesz uratować ojca jak w „Gwiezdnych wojnach”?

source_text: The guy needs to be in jail… I just want this to end.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.The guy needs to be in jail… I just want this to end.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.The guy needs to be in jail… I just want this to end."

translation: Ten facet powinien siedzieć w więzieniu… Chcę tylko, żeby to się skończyło.

source_text: We should have told you. But in our mind, Kirk was dead.

structure.raw_value: HeSaEx.We should have told you. But in our mind, Kirk was dead.
structure.script_literal: "HeSaEx.We should have told you. But in our mind, Kirk was dead."

translation: Powinniśmy byli ci powiedzieć. Ale dla nas Kirk już nie żył.

source_text: He’s a psychopath. I didn’t want him in our lives.

structure.raw_value: CaSaEx.He’s a psychopath. I didn’t want him in our lives.
structure.script_literal: "CaSaEx.He’s a psychopath. I didn’t want him in our lives."

translation: To psychopata. Nie chciałam, żeby był częścią naszego życia.

source_text: You could have just told me.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You could have just told me.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You could have just told me."

translation: Mogliście mi po prostu powiedzieć.

source_text: The man you had in your mind was who we wanted you to live up to.

structure.raw_value: HeSaEx.The man you had in your mind was who we wanted you to live up to.
structure.script_literal: "HeSaEx.The man you had in your mind was who we wanted you to live up to."

translation: Chcieliśmy, żebyś dorastał, starając się być takim człowiekiem, za jakiego go uważałeś.

source_text: It’s true. You were such a good kid… We didn’t want to lose that.

structure.raw_value: CaSaEx.It’s true. You were such a good kid… We didn’t want to lose that.
structure.script_literal: "CaSaEx.It’s true. You were such a good kid… We didn’t want to lose that."

translation: To prawda. Byłeś takim dobrym dzieciakiem… Nie chcieliśmy tego stracić.

source_text: You didn’t trust me?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.You didn’t trust me?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.You didn’t trust me?"

translation: Nie ufaliście mi?

source_text: You don’t know Kirk. He would have manipulated you. He would have dragged you into his den of thieves.

structure.raw_value: HeWoEx.You don’t know Kirk. He would have manipulated you. He would have dragged you into his den of thieves.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoEx.You don’t know Kirk. He would have manipulated you. He would have dragged you into his den of thieves."

translation: Nie znasz Kirka. Manipulowałby tobą. Wciągnąłby cię do swojej bandy złodziei.

source_text: You don’t know that.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.You don’t know that.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.You don’t know that."

translation: Tego nie wiesz.

source_text: Look what he became. I’m glad you never knew him.

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx^.Look what he became. I’m glad you never knew him.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx^.Look what he became. I’m glad you never knew him."

translation: Popatrz, kim się stał. Cieszę się, że nigdy go nie poznałeś.

source_text: Chloe!

structure.raw_value: HnShOpNo1^.Chloe!
structure.script_literal: "HnShOpNo1^.Chloe!"

translation: Chloe!

source_text: I’m being honest with you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ChSaEx^.I’m being honest with you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaEx^.I’m being honest with you, 1Hero."

translation: Mówię ci szczerze, 1Hero.

source_text: … I don’t know what to think. This is all so crazy…

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.… I don’t know what to think. This is all so crazy…
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.… I don’t know what to think. This is all so crazy…"

translation: … Nie wiem, co o tym myśleć. To wszystko jest takie szalone…

source_text: How could this happen?

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.How could this happen?
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.How could this happen?"

translation: Jak do tego doszło?

source_text: The Lord tests us in mysterious ways.

structure.raw_value: JuSaEx.The Lord tests us in mysterious ways.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaEx.The Lord tests us in mysterious ways."

translation: Pan wystawia nas na próbę na różne tajemnicze sposoby.

source_text: There’s no test here… The man will go to jail.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.There’s no test here… The man will go to jail.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.There’s no test here… The man will go to jail."

translation: Tu nie ma żadnej próby… Ten człowiek trafi do więzienia.

source_text: I do hope you never have to face him.

structure.raw_value: CaSaOp.I do hope you never have to face him.
structure.script_literal: "CaSaOp.I do hope you never have to face him."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że nigdy nie będziesz musiała się z nim mierzyć.

source_text: That’s not for me to decide… Kimura has her own plans.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.That’s not for me to decide… Kimura has her own plans.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.That’s not for me to decide… Kimura has her own plans."

translation: To nie ja o tym decyduję… Kimura ma własne plany.

source_text: Does she know…?

structure.raw_value: HeBaOp.Does she know…?
structure.script_literal: "HeBaOp.Does she know…?"

translation: Czy ona wie…?

source_text: No. She won’t know this… It’s not relevant.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.No. She won’t know this… It’s not relevant.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.No. She won’t know this… It’s not relevant."

translation: Nie. Tego się nie dowie… To nieistotne.

source_text: I’ll tell you one thing: If that man comes snooping around the farm again, I’ll take him down myself.

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx.I’ll tell you one thing: If that man comes snooping around the farm again, I’ll take him down myself.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx.I’ll tell you one thing: If that man comes snooping around the farm again, I’ll take him down myself."

translation: Powiem ci jedno: jeśli ten facet znowu zacznie kręcić się po farmie, sama go załatwię.

source_text: You go, Ma!

structure.raw_value: HnHaAg^.You go, Ma!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAg^.You go, Ma!"

translation: Dajesz, mamo!

source_text: Sounds like you should stay away from him.

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp^.Sounds like you should stay away from him.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp^.Sounds like you should stay away from him."

translation: Wygląda na to, że lepiej trzymać się od niego z daleka.

source_text: You are welcome here.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.You are welcome here.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.You are welcome here."

translation: Jesteś tu mile widziana.

source_text: I think it’s best to stay here, at least until I can learn more about what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I think it’s best to stay here, at least until I can learn more about what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I think it’s best to stay here, at least until I can learn more about what’s going on."

translation: Najlepiej będzie tu zostać, przynajmniej dopóki nie dowiem się, co się dzieje.

source_text: Where will they sleep?

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl^.Where will they sleep?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl^.Where will they sleep?"

translation: Gdzie będą spać?

source_text: There’s plenty of room.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.There’s plenty of room.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.There’s plenty of room."

translation: Miejsca jest pod dostatkiem.

source_text: Tomorrow morning I’m heading to the church to check up on Father Solomon… Perhaps Sister Judy can come with me.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Tomorrow morning I’m heading to the church to check up on Father Solomon… Perhaps Sister Judy can come with me.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Tomorrow morning I’m heading to the church to check up on Father Solomon… Perhaps Sister Judy can come with me."

translation: Jutro rano idę do kościoła sprawdzić, co u ojca Solomona… Może siostra Judy pójdzie ze mną.

source_text: Oh! I like that idea very much.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.Oh! I like that idea very much.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.Oh! I like that idea very much."

translation: Och! Bardzo mi się podoba ten pomysł.

source_text: Aww! I wanted to have fun with Sister Judy!

structure.raw_value: HnSaOp^.Aww! I wanted to have fun with Sister Judy!
structure.script_literal: "HnSaOp^.Aww! I wanted to have fun with Sister Judy!"

translation: Aww! Chciałam się pobawić z siostrą Judy!

source_text: Then go to church tomorrow morning.

structure.raw_value: ChFlEx^.Then go to church tomorrow morning.
structure.script_literal: "ChFlEx^.Then go to church tomorrow morning."

translation: To idź jutro rano do kościoła.

source_text: Oh, fooey!

structure.raw_value: HnAnDeNo1^.Oh, fooey!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnDeNo1^.Oh, fooey!"

translation: Ech, szkoda!

source_text: If you’re planning to leave, you better get moving. The storm is only going to get worse later tonight.

structure.raw_value: CaWoEx.If you’re planning to leave, you better get moving. The storm is only going to get worse later tonight.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoEx.If you’re planning to leave, you better get moving. The storm is only going to get worse later tonight."

translation: Jeśli zamierzacie wyjeżdżać, lepiej ruszajcie. Później w nocy burza tylko się nasili.

source_text: Thank you for the hospitality, Miss Heather.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Thank you for the hospitality, Miss Heather.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Thank you for the hospitality, Miss Heather."

translation: Dziękuję za gościnę, panno Heather.

source_text: You’re welcome here any time, Sister.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.You’re welcome here any time, Sister.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.You’re welcome here any time, Sister."

translation: Zawsze jesteś tu mile widziana, siostro.

source_text: See you tomorrow morning, Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp^.See you tomorrow morning, Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp^.See you tomorrow morning, Sister Judy."

translation: Do zobaczenia jutro rano, siostro Judy.

source_text: Goodbye.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Goodbye.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Goodbye."

translation: Do widzenia.
